summary: Derived PartialOrd delegates to the inner float, making NaN comparisons unordered despite OrderedFloat's total Ord implementation. The fix implements partial_cmp as Some(self.cmp(other)) and makes cmp compare inner floats directly to avoid recursion. The implementation reversal below restores the exact parent region. The fix adds a detecting test in tests/test.rs: describe! ordered_float32, it "should compare NaN with comparison operators".
